outcome: Surgical intervention (cystoscopy, transurethral resection, hysterectomy, bilateral oophorectomy, partial cystectomy)
cohort: A 34-year-old woman presented with a 3-year history of dysuria and frequency, and a past medical history of cesarean sections.
finding: Endometriosis and endocervicosis should be considered as important differential diagnoses in patients with gross hematuria and those suspected to have urothelial carcinomas.
